title: MiniMax H3: An Innovative Multi-Modal AI Video Model
description: MiniMax has released its H3 video model, an omni-modal AI that generates 15-second 2K clips with native stereo audio, challenging Seedance 2.5.

sections.heading: Introduction
paragraphs: China's MiniMax has released its H3 video model, an omni-modal AI that generates 15-second 2K clips with native stereo audio, according to Reuters.

sections.heading: Features of MiniMax H3
paragraphs: MarkTechPost reports that MiniMax H3 is an innovative multi-modal AI model that generates 15-second 2K clips with native stereo audio.

sections.heading: Competition
paragraphs: Open Source For You states that MiniMax H3 is set to challenge Seedance 2.5, another prominent AI model.
